THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
No representation for the petitioners even in the afternoon session.
On 03.03.2023 also there was no representation for the petitioners.
On that day, it was made clear that if, on the next date of hearing there is no representation for the petitioners, necessary orders would be passed for dismissal of the petition.
It appears that petitioners are not interested in prosecuting the petition.
Hence, petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
